correctness.rationale: For U=X_i/sigma,V=X_(i+1)/sigma and L=S_n/sigma, the Gaussian exponential-tilt identity gives Cov(1_{UV<0},L^2)=[rho(a^2+b^2)-2ab]/(pi sqrt(1-rho^2)), with a,b the covariance row sums. Summing yields F_n=Sum_{i=1}^{n-1}[rho(b_i^2+b_(i+1)^2)-2b_i b_(i+1)] and the exact closed polynomial-rational expression using t=rho^n. Independent rational arithmetic matched the two expressions for n=2..15 and five rho values. Uniform regimes are stated for FIXED c>0: rho=-1+c/sqrt(n) gives 1/2-c^2; even n at -1+c/n^2 gives n^3 F -> c^2(c-12)/6; odd n gives n F ->2c. The even c=5,c=20 small layer and c=1 square-root layer prove negative-positive-negative and at least two distinct roots for large even n. No exact number of zeros or critical c behavior claimed.
residual_risks: Asymptotics along each parity assume fixed positive c, not uniform c or exact critical values.

These exact structural boundary facts go beyond a routine closed covariance formula or arbitrary finite parameter scan and could inform asymptotic statistical analysis.
